tags.TITLE: Phonophobia
tags.LYRICS:
[Verse 1]
Take it or leave it, it's my final approach now
I don't give a fuck about what others think now
Stare at the sidewalk for hours and hope now
That things may just turn out right
It might, it might
Really all I care about is music and my friends
Used to care about dying, but I overthought it
I really thought the sky was gonna fall someday
But that didn't scare you off
So we talked and talked

[Chorus]
I can't seem to comprehend the meaning of all of this
And some problems are easily too big for me to fix
Sometimes I think that it's kinda funny that we met
Sucks I didn't ask you to stay, and just like that you left

[Verse 2]
You're the CEO of giving second chances
And when I thought about it, I made some sense of it
I talked to you for hours about your dreams
Of being on the TV
You and me, both free
Something about the way you talk is calming
And the more I think about it, it's alarming!
You dress accordingly to what your mood ring says
And you've been blue for a while
Are you tired? Tired


[Chorus]
I can't seem to comprehend the meaning of all of this
And some problems are easily too big for me to fix
Sometimes I think that it's kinda funny that we met
Sucks I didn't ask you to stay, and just like that you left

[Bridge]
Dance around, dance around, dance around, but don't you dare make a sound
